name: Columbia (STS 61-C)
about: Columbia (STS 61-C) (1986-003A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1986 Jan 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1986 Jan 14), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW22); its coordinates are written from memory
